title: Implement registered control-flow node types
objective: Deliver a versioned control-node registry that provides explicit bounded loop, parallel, join, switch, map, try, retry, timeout, return, and fail semantics.

branch.name: wi-0004-control-nodes
branch.rationale: The branch isolates the control-node registry and loop schema migration.

request.text: Create WI-0004 for langgraph-exec: Implement registered control-flow node types and migrate loop to control.loop.

scope.name: control-loop
scope.description: Migrate the existing loop/v1 artifact and kind: loop contract to control-loop/v1 and kind: control.loop with explicit finite counters and budgets.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-parallel
scope.description: Add bounded fan-out execution for independent registered components with explicit branch limits and isolated writes.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-join
scope.description: Add barrier/join semantics for parallel branches with explicit reducer-based merge behavior.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-switch
scope.description: Add a registered multi-way selector node with explicit cases and a required default route.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-map
scope.description: Add bounded collection mapping over a registered component with deterministic ordering and item limits.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-try
scope.description: Add structured success/failure branching around a registered component without silently swallowing errors.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-retry
scope.description: Add bounded retry behavior with explicit attempt limits, retryable error selection, and exhaustion status.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-timeout
scope.description: Add bounded execution deadlines and structured timeout results for registered components.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-return
scope.description: Add explicit branch/graph termination with declared output ports.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

scope.name: control-fail
scope.description: Add an intentional structured failure node with stable error code, message, and port behavior.
scope.reason: Control flow must be explicit, bounded, versioned, and independently testable.

nonGoals.name: persistence
nonGoals.description: Do not implement checkpointing, interrupt/resume, or durable side-effect receipts.
nonGoals.reason: These require a later persistence work item.

nonGoals.name: live-providers
nonGoals.description: Do not require live provider calls for control-node unit evidence.

nonGoals.name: arbitrary-code
nonGoals.description: Do not allow control nodes to execute arbitrary JavaScript, shell, or dynamic code.

items.name: control-loop
items.description: Migrate the existing loop/v1 artifact and kind: loop contract to control-loop/v1 and kind: control.loop with explicit finite counters and budgets.
items.reason: The control.loop control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Legacy loop/v1 and kind: loop are rejected by default; control-loop/v1 and kind: control.loop validate, inspect, and execute with bounded statuses.

items.name: control-parallel
items.description: Add bounded fan-out execution for independent registered components with explicit branch limits and isolated writes.
items.reason: The control.parallel control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Parallel branches execute deterministically under a finite branch budget and conflicting writes fail closed.

items.name: control-join
items.description: Add barrier/join semantics for parallel branches with explicit reducer-based merge behavior.
items.reason: The control.join control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Join waits for all declared branches, applies reducers, and rejects missing/conflicting branch outputs.

items.name: control-switch
items.description: Add a registered multi-way selector node with explicit cases and a required default route.
items.reason: The control.switch control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Switch selects a declared case deterministically and routes unknown values through the declared default.

items.name: control-map
items.description: Add bounded collection mapping over a registered component with deterministic ordering and item limits.
items.reason: The control.map control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Map rejects unbounded collections, enforces the item budget, and returns deterministic ordered results.

items.name: control-try
items.description: Add structured success/failure branching around a registered component without silently swallowing errors.
items.reason: The control.try control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Try emits explicit success or failure branch state and preserves bounded error information.

items.name: control-retry
items.description: Add bounded retry behavior with explicit attempt limits, retryable error selection, and exhaustion status.
items.reason: The control.retry control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Retry performs only finite attempts, retries only declared failures, and returns deterministic exhaustion.

items.name: control-timeout
items.description: Add bounded execution deadlines and structured timeout results for registered components.
items.reason: The control.timeout control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Timeout returns a stable timeout result and prevents late component output from mutating graph state.

items.name: control-return
items.description: Add explicit branch/graph termination with declared output ports.
items.reason: The control.return control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Return terminates the active branch with only declared output data and stable terminal status.

items.name: control-fail
items.description: Add an intentional structured failure node with stable error code, message, and port behavior.
items.reason: The control.fail control capability is required for complete declarative workflow control flow.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Fail produces a bounded structured error without throwing unbounded internal details.
